title: AG40001: Mechanism And Dynamics Of Machinery
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Mechanism: Mechanisms and conversion of motion. Analysis and synthesis of
simple mechanisms. Farm Machinery Mechanisms: Mechanisms used in crop
production and processing machines. Friction Devices: Friction. Belt, rope and
chain drives. Brakes and dynamometers. Common mechanisms: Gearing. Tractor gear
trains. Cams. Governors. Balancing: Balancing of rotating and reciprocating
parts. Flywheel. Introduction to vibration in machines.
